items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I had McGee, George, myself, and I had, who had on trumpet at the end?

ctx.x: Now, that's not Herb Moran's brother. That's another McGee. Another McGee. Yeah, Herb's brother's dead.
I had McGee, George, myself, and I had, who had on trumpet at the end?
When Boyk. Boyk, Boyk, Boyk, Boyk, over the river. Boyk, he played trumpet. He put the trumpet down and played bass afterwards.
